question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank No. 1.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"cease"** means to stop or come to an end. (अंत होना)
 
• Example: The factory **ceased** operations due to financial difficulties.
 
• In the context of the passage, the 500/- and 1000/- rupee notes would "cease" to be legal tender, indicating that they would no longer be accepted as valid currency.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **'Option 2' i.e. 'cease.'**

**Correct Sentence:** *"When Prime Minister Narendra Modi announced that rupees with the denominations of 500/- and 1000/- would **cease** to be the legal tender from the 9th of November, the whole country was stunned."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Unify** (एकीकरण करना): To make or become united, uniform, or whole.

 
 
• **Example:** The new leader aimed to unify the divided country.
 
 
 
• **Seize** (जब्त करना): To take hold of suddenly and forcibly.
 
 
• **Example:** The police seized the stolen goods from the warehouse.
 
 
 
• **Collaborate** (सहयोग करना): To work jointly with others or together especially in an intellectual endeavor.
 
 
• **Example:** The two corporations decided to collaborate on a new project.
